description: A bright, youthful feminine voice with an energetic, confident, friendly, slightly tomboyish character. Use lively and expressive delivery, crisp articulation, and a naturally upbeat rhythm. Give the character a sense of courage and determination, with warmth and a hint of playful spirit. Inspired by the broad vocal qualities of an upbeat adventure-game heroine, not an exact imitation of any specific character or voice actor.

en.text: Layla had only one choice: cross the bridge before sunset. The winds were growing stronger, and the ground was trembling beneath her feet. But she refused to turn back.

ar.text: لم يكن أمام ليلى سوى خيار واحد: عبور الجسر قبل غروب الشمس. الرياح تزداد قوة، والأرض تهتز تحت قدميها، لكنها لم تتراجع
